QuestInfo.name: In Search of the Eighth Storybook 3
QuestInfo.0: Ask Wiz the Librarian about the eighth storybook.
QuestInfo.1: Wiz the Librarian says he's found a connection between two of the twisted stories, but he needs you to collect #b50 Tiger Skins#k so he can complete his research.
QuestInfo.2: You gave 50 Tiger Skins to Wiz the Librarian.

0.0: Yes, if I crossreference these Tiger Stamps with those Pounders, then...\r\n#L0##bHave you located the eighth storybook?#l\n#k
0.1: Not yet, but soon. I am the world's greatest detective-librarian, after all. Now I just need some Tiger Skins from the Hoguls.

no.0: Very well. I shall fight the Hoguls myself! *Gulp!*

1.0: How goes the good fight? Do you have the Tiger Skins?\r\n#L0##bIndeed. On this day, I have skinned many tigers in the name of literacy.#l\n#k
1.1: That ought to teach those tigers to read more! Now, let's see here...

yes.0: See, I can trace which story each of these creatures comes from... Great Scott, they're all from fables!

item.0: Hoguls are a superstitious cowardly lot. I trust you'll make quick work of them.
